rawInput.answer: Application-level route handling is wired up in lib/application.js: app.init() lazily creates `this.router` (a `new Router({...})` instance), and app.use/app.route/app.all/methods.forEach(...) delegate to `this.router` (e.g. `this.router.handle(req, res, done)` at line 178, `this.router.route(path)` at line 258). The router itself is NOT implemented inside expressjs/express — it's the external npm package `router` (`var Router = require('router');`, declared as a dependency `"router": "^2.2.0"` in package.json), so express only wires the app-level API on top of it.
